articles.summary: Coastal communities in Virginia face growing pressure from erosion, storms and rising sea levels. Beach nourishment—adding suitable sand to an eroding shoreline—can restore beach width, strengthen its coastal-defense function and help reduce risks to nearby communities and infrastructure.
